title: V02 on the timestamped announcements: announcement categories, 20-session drift after the day (top-500 stocks)
hypothesis: After an announcement of a given category, the stock's 20-session return beyond Nifty differs from zero in the stated direction (V02's rule, on NSE's timestamped announcements instead of the PR files)
category_rule: india.przip._cat on NSE's category plus the subject text (the PR files' keyword rules); price-band hits are left out (not announcements)
timing:
(the one rule that differs, because the source has a time of day): an announcement disseminated on a trading day at or before 15:30 IST
is known before that session's close, so its outcome runs from that close (as the PR file of day d after the close of d); after 15:30, or on a
non-trading day, from the close of the next session.
outcome: as V02: close of the event session to close 20 sessions later, minus Nifty; |drift| above 100% dropped
bar: the registry's standard family rule (family events, all rows ever counted)
